item_de: Zusammengesetzter Governance-Index
item_en: Composite governance index
derivation: Unweighted sum of gov_ai_tools, gov_training and gov_guidelines.
used_in: Table 2; Section 4.3; Section 5.1.
notes: Loosely adapted from the general governance dimensions in Klotz et al. (2019): AI tools correspond to systems gap resolution, training to awareness measures, and formal guidelines to policy setup. The fourth dimension, monitoring and identification, is omitted because it is not observable through physician self-report. The index is descriptive; it is not entered into the regression models, which retain the three components separately. Construction is documented in governance_index_construction.pdf.
